name: REV HD Hex Motor No Gearbox
source: REV Robotics product page REV-41-1291, Specifications list
remarks: Brushed 550-class motor. rated_current_a is stall current (8.5 A). No-load current 400 mA. Max output power 15 W. Body diameter 37 mm.

name: REV HD Hex Motor 40:1 Spur Gearbox
feedback: integrated encoder 28 counts/rev at motor (HD Hex Motor)
source: REV Robotics product page REV-41-1301, Specifications list
remarks: Stall torque 594.7 oz-in (4.2 N·m) as published. Weight includes motor. 5 mm hex output, 40 mm long. Page does not list voltage or stall current (HD Hex Motor is 12 V, 8.5 A stall per REV-41-1291). List price $34.50 (sale price shown $29.33).

name: REV Core Hex Motor
feedback: magnetic quadrature encoder 288 counts/rev at output
source: REV Robotics product page REV-41-1300, Specifications list
remarks: rated_current_a is stall current (4.4 A). Weight published as 7 oz (converted). 5 mm female hex output. Encoder 4 counts/rev at motor.

name: REV NEO Brushless Motor V1.1
source: REV Robotics product page REV-21-1650, Specifications list (empirical values)
remarks: Brushless; needs brushless controller. Empirical stall torque 2.6 N·m, stall current 105 A (rated_current_a), free current 1.8 A, peak power 406 W. Theoretical stall 3.75 N·m / 150 A, 540 W. 473 Kv. Discontinued, replaced by NEO 2.0; list $50 (sale $42.50).

name: REV NEO 2.0 Brushless Motor
source: REV Robotics product page REV-21-1653, Specifications list
remarks: Brushless; needs brushless controller. Stall torque and stall current (rated_current_a, 150 A) are REV's theoretical values; theoretical peak power 540 W. 473 Kv. 15T spline output shaft.

name: REV NEO 550 Brushless Motor
source: REV Robotics product page REV-21-1651, Specifications list
remarks: Brushless; needs brushless controller. Values measured with SPARK MAX at default settings. Stall current 100 A (rated_current_a), free current 1.4 A, peak power 279 W. 917 Kv. 550-series mounting.

name: REV NEO Vortex Brushless Motor
feedback: integrated encoder 7168 counts/rev with SPARK Flex (42 with SPARK MAX)
source: REV Robotics product page REV-21-1652, Motor Specifications list
remarks: Brushless; needs brushless controller (SPARK Flex dock or Solo Adapter). Stall current 211 A (rated_current_a), free current 3.6 A, peak power 640 W (375 W at 40 A). 565 Kv. 1/2 in hex through-bore rotor.
